title: kb-sprint runs headless as a restartable sprint runner
goal: python3 _tools/autopilot.py runner start SP launches claude -p running /kb-sprint run SP in its own worktree, with settings and plugins passed explicitly and its stream logged under _cache/autopilot/; the skill's headless path never calls AskUserQuestion, records each gate with its recommendation and goes on, and exits after K landed items or its first compaction with a status file the manager reads; autopilot.py runner-status SP prints landed items, gates, bugs filed and the exit cause in under 1000 characters; a relaunched runner continues from horizon
